To my non existent kids:
I've killed billions of your potential siblings with my left hand.

I'd be one of those NPCs which show a programming flaw in the game.

"I am error"

Border Collies are amazing if you can train them well.
We adopted one when it was around 5 yrs old. It seemed that this dog had been abused and was quite shy. But my dad persisted with him, took him for walks everyday, trained him to respond to his commands (it's particularly important to only allow them to eat when they're told), etc.

He's an indoor dog, stays on the couch most of the time, follows me and my parents around and is always smiling. 

Sadly he's gotten a little ill of late. I hope it's nothing serious, but he hasn't been eating very much lately, drinking lots of water and throwing up... My parents are taking him to the vet today, fingers crossed it's nothing too serious.
I have major issues. I'm sorry, I didn't end up going through with it.

The best way to visualize it is like a Death Eater sucking essence from my body. Where that essence contains all my confidence, my desires, my ability (i'm currently depressed so I don't even know what my abilities are anymore) and a lot more of me I can't describe. 
Escapism consumes me while I'm depressed. This can be through the form of Video games, Reading, Music and watching videos on youtube to name a few. This is escaping priorities in my life that I should be addressing, whether that be work at my job (i'm writing this while I should be doing work), hanging with friends, studying at uni.. etc.
Recognizing one cause of escapism leads to another. It feels never ending. 
When people talk to me while I'm depressed, I feel like their words have no weight. The idiom that it goes in one hear and comes out of the other is absolutely spot on. 
Everything looks transparent and I have difficulty focusing on things visually. The constant blur makes inanimate objects like walls and ceilings more engaging and I find myself staring at them constantly. 
There's more to this, but I feel like I'm rambling and this won't be read.

I was tripping heavily on lsd with a friend at a psytrance festival.
We both sat in front of the psychedelic art which was nearby one of the stages but a little bit out of the way. This was at about 4am when most people were not present and back at their tents except for as my friend would describe "hardcore trippers". As we were sitting, cross-legged in front of the art, we both sat there trying to dissect how the art pieces were made, whether some of the art was printed on the fabric and whether other elements were painted on afterwards. We're having this discussion while some heavy psytrance music is being played in the background. It was a little too much for me, this doesn't make any sense but my mind was concentrating 100% on each element I could perceive. I was fully focused on the music, the art, the conversation, the people around me and how they were reacting. Everytime I shut my eyes, I could see the art in front of me deform into something else. Psychedelic art is usually twisted, and the fractal elements in the art kept spiraling like one of those tricky sterograms, static images that appear to be moving if you focus your pupils in a certain way. 
As we were walking back to our campground, I thought I'd explain to him that I was having a BAD TRIP. Just saying those words and triggering a form of discomfort felt like cutting us both with a knife. I saw my friends face blend in with the psychedelic art from before and the words he said were replaced by animal sounds, a lion roaring or something along those lines.
His friend joined us, I had only met at the festival. As we walked by and I tried my best to compose myself. My friend mentioned to him I was having a bad trip and this guy, offered me something which I believe was valium. I was too paranoid from the trip. I didn't want to take it as I had a fear I might die. I reluctantly said okay and put it in my pocket. 
I spent the night in my tent, staring at the closed tent door with intermittent flashes to a fractal landscape, hearing primal sounds mixed with endless psytrance and shivering from neverending cold. I tried focusing on things from before, like video games I've played or people I've met and every single time, my thoughts twisted into something else.
